newsitem.title: UK: Wolstenholme Rink falls on profits warning.
newsitem.headline: Wolstenholme Rink falls on profits warning.

text.p: Shares in printing materials and chemicals manufacturer Wolstenholme Rink Plc were sharply lower in early afternoon trading on Friday, after the group warned that its second half performance would not meet its expectations.
Shares in Wolstenholme were down 92-1/2 pence to 865 pence at 1244 GMT. One market-maker in the stock said, however, that trading volumes were very thin.

The company said earlier that an improvement in trading seen in July and August had not been sustained in September and October, and it now expected second half profits to be around the same as the first half.

The difficulties facing printing businesses were highlighted on Thursday by Wace Group Plc, whose shares plunged in value when it too issued a profits warning on the back of tough conditions in September and October.
Wace shares, which dropped nearly 50 percent on Thursday, were up just 1/2p at 70 pence in early afternoon trading on Friday.
